description: Beregnet utslipp i kollektivtransporten is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.entur.no. Datasettet består av beregnede utslipp på ruteplandata fra Entur. Ruteplandataene (GTFS) er åpne data distribuert av Entur, og vil være historiske og planlagte reiser minimum tre måneder frem i tid. De beregnede utslippene kommer fra Sintef sin Energimodul, en fysikkmodell som beregner utslippet basert på energiforbruk. Coverage: NO. Its keywords include co2, energimodul, kollektivtransport, utslipp, ruteplan, sintef. The listing shows 1 download or service links in SQL. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
